drivingQuestion: Why is she not suspected betrothed, and why teach land and money separately?

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ וְנֵיחוּשׁ שֶׁמָּא יֵשׁ לוֹ! וְעוֹד, תַּנְיָא: חָיְישִׁינַן שֶׁמָּא יֵשׁ לוֹ! לָא קַשְׁיָא. הָא בְּקִידּוּשֵׁי וַדַּאי, הָא בְּקִידּוּשֵׁי סָפֵק.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» With regard to the statement of the mishna that she is betrothed only if he actually possesses a beit kor of earth, the Gemara asks: «And let us be concerned» that «perhaps he» in fact «possesses» land of this size. «And furthermore, it is» explicitly «taught» in a baraita that «we are concerned» in this situation that «perhaps he possesses» land of this size. The Gemara answers: It is «not difficult,» as «this» case, the one in the mishna, is referring «to a definite betrothal,» which has not yet been established because he has not proven he owns a field of this kind; and «that» case, the one in the baraita, is referring «to an uncertain betrothal.»

segments.he: לְמָה לִי לְמִיתְנֵא גַּבֵּי אַרְעָא וּלְמָה לִי לְמִיתְנֵא גַּבֵּי זוּזֵי! צְרִיכָא, דְּאִי אַשְׁמְעִינַן גַּבֵּי זוּזֵי, מִשּׁוּם דַּעֲבִידִי אִינָשֵׁי דְּמַצְנְעִי. אֲבָל אַרְעָא, אֵימָא: אִי דְּאִית לֵיהּ אַרְעָא – קָלָא אִית לֵיהּ, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «Why do I» need this mishna «to teach» this halakha «with regard to land, and why do I» also need the previous mishna «to teach» the same ruling «with regard to money?» There is no clear difference between the two cases. The Gemara answers: It is «necessary» to state the halakha in both cases, «as had» one mishna «taught us» this halakha only «with regard to money» one might have said that it is only in that case that it is uncertain whether she is betrothed, «because people tend to hide» their money, and therefore his financial status might not be well known. «But» in the case of «land, you» might «say» that «if he had land» this fact «would» generate «publicity,» as one cannot hide land. The mishna therefore «teaches us» that it is also possible for him to own land without people being aware of it.
